title: Explosive Revelation
next_chapter_hook: When that giant eye that enveloped the heavens slowly opened, Chen Ji felt a pressure that transcended realms—not the aura any cultivator could emit, but the will-projection of Heavenly Dao itself.

text.content: The footsteps drew closer, yet Chen Ji did not leave immediately. He tucked the secret treasure into his sleeve, his gaze sweeping across the fissure in the rock wall that nearly merged with it. The final words left by that figure who had vanished into the Void still festered in his heart like a poisoned thorn—'Your father died deservedly.' Four words, light as a feather, yet heavy as a mountain. He took a deep breath, his fingertips tracing the treasure's patterns, and let out a cold laugh. Since he'd already come, how could he abandon his mission halfway? The direction of the approaching footsteps conveniently pointed the way—the Jade Slip lay at the deepest part of the ruins.

Chen Ji squeezed sideways into the fissure, the narrow passage barely wide enough for one person. He protected himself with spiritual energy, feeling his way through the darkness. After roughly a hundred zhang, the passage suddenly opened up, revealing a dust-covered stone chamber. In the chamber's center, on a stone platform, lay a Jade Slip, its surface marked with the Tianqing Sect's insignia, yet covered by a layer of诡异的 black rune patterns. Just as he was about to reach for it, the Tianji Record in his sleeve suddenly shook violently—an unprecedented reaction, as if encountering something terrifying. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul voice echoed in his mind, carrying a rare solemnity: 'Be careful... that is a seal.'

'A seal?' Chen Ji frowned but did not withdraw his hand. He studied the black rune patterns and discovered they were not merely a simple prohibition, but an extremely exquisite formation array—drawing upon the power of Heavenly Dao, sealing not just the Jade Slip itself, but the memories contained within. 'Mo Xiansheng,' he said deeply, 'did the Founder personally set this seal?' The residual soul fell silent for a moment, then sighed: 'Yes. This seal was placed to protect this truth, preventing certain... entities from sensing it.' Chen Ji's eyes gleamed sharply. He bit his fingertip and pressed his blood onto the Jade Slip. The Tianji Record's trembling grew even more intense, yet seemed to be resonating with something. The black rune patterns began to slowly recede, revealing the warm jade luster beneath.

dialogue.content: Father... what exactly were you entangled in?

text.content: The moment the Jade Slip entered his hand, a surge of powerful spiritual consciousness information flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. As the images flickered, he saw a scene both familiar and foreign—it was the founding of the Tianqing Sect, with the Founder standing in the clouds, overlooking the vast earth. However, in the next instant, a crack appeared in the sky, and a massive eye peered through the gap. That eye had no pupils, only endless pallor, yet radiated a suffocating pressure. The Founder's face instantly turned ashen, but he did not kneel. Instead, he managed to clasp his hands and say: 'Who... who are you, honored one?' The eye gave no answer, merely rotating slowly, as if examining an ant.

dialogue.content: 【Heavenly Dao's Eye】'I am the will-projection of Heavenly Dao. You are honored to become a... chess piece for this one in the mortal realm.'

text.content: The images continued. Chen Ji witnessed the Founder's struggle and resistance—he tried to escape, tried to fight back, even attempted self-destruction. But every time, that eye would appear at the critical moment, crushing his hopes. The Founder gradually fell into despair. He began acting according to the Heavenly Dao's Eye's instructions: establishing the Tianqing Sect, searching for Tianji Record fragments, cultivating successors... everything proceeded under that eye's watchful gaze. 'This is not cooperation,' the Founder wrote in the Jade Slip, his handwriting hurried and trembling, 'this is domestication. It needs an obedient chess piece, a pawn it can discard at any moment.'

Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly, anger burning like wildfire in his chest. But he suppressed his emotions and continued watching. The scene shifted to decades later; the Founder's hair had turned gray. He seemed to be waiting for something. 'The Tianji Record chose Chen Xuan,' Mo Xiansheng's voice timely interjected, carrying a hint of complexity, 'the first time in a hundred years it had actively chosen an heir.' Chen Ji's heart was shaken. In the scene, a young man's figure appeared—it was his father, Chen Xuan. The Founder looked at Chen Xuan, a flicker of hope crossing his eyes: 'You came... the one chosen by the Tianji Record.' Chen Xuan knelt on one knee: 'Disciple Chen Xuan greets the Founder.'

The scenes in the Jade Slip continued. Chen Ji watched his father hold several secret meetings with the Founder, each discussing how to break free from the Heavenly Dao's Eye's control. The Founder told his father that the Tianji Record was not a creation of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but an ancient treasure left behind. It selected its master based on only one criterion—whether one could break the shackles of destiny. 'That thing...' the Founder pointed at the sky, 'it merely operates under the name of the Tianji Record. The true Tianji Record contains mysteries even Heavenly Dao cannot touch.' Fire ignited in Chen Xuan's eyes: 'This disciple is willing to exhaust everything for the common people of the world.' The Founder nodded, taking a fragment from his sleeve—another part of the Tianji Record.

However, the moment Chen Xuan was about to accept the fragment, the sky abruptly changed color. That massive eye appeared again, larger and more terrifying than ever before. The Founder's face instantly turned deathly pale. He shouted, stuffing the fragment into Chen Xuan's hand: 'Go! Take it and leave!' But Chen Xuan did not move. He turned to face that eye, his voice calm yet firm: 'Elder, I know you have been listening all along. My father died by your hand, my wife died by your hand, my sister was taken by you... this blood feud, my Chen family shall never forget across generations.' Chen Ji's eyes widened—he had never heard his father mention any of this.

【Heavenly Dao's Eye】'The Chen family...' that eye rotated slightly, as if searching for something, 'Interesting. Does an ant dare hold grudges against Heavenly Dao?' In the next instant, Chen Ji watched his father's body begin to disintegrate—not from an attack, but the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly erasing his existence. The Founder's wail rang out, yet it could not stop this. 'No!' Chen Ji violently opened his eyes, gasping剧烈. He discovered he was drenched in cold sweat, his hands gripping the Jade Slip so tightly his knuckles were white. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a rare heaviness: 'This is... the truth of your father's death.'

choice.prompt: The truth of his father's death ignited Chen Ji's rage. At this moment, he faced a choice:

choices.text: Immediately pursue the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.description: Confronting the Heavenly Dao's Eye with his current strength would almost certainly mean death, but Chen Ji couldn't care less.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of perishing on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Release his rage, even if only a sliver
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk—the Heavenly Dao's Eye is an existence beyond comprehension

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly stood up, his eyes bloodshot. He couldn't care about any plans or restraint anymore—blood feud for killing a father is an irreconcilable hatred! The Tianji Record in his hand shook violently, as if trying to break free from its restraints. 'Father...' his voice was low like a wild beast, 'your child has been unfilial, making you wait too long!' He rushed toward the depths of the secret realm, his spiritual energy burning wildly, completely ignoring the Tianji Record's warnings. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: 'Chen Ji! Calm down! That thing is not something you can handle now!' But how could Chen Ji listen anymore?

choices.description: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his anger, turning hatred into deeper patience. He knew that charging forward now would only mean death. Only a more elaborate chess game could kill Heaven.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the location of the complete Tianji Record, thoroughly understand the enemy
choices.risk_hint: Inner torment—watching the enemy yet unable to act

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his chest heaving violently. His hands trembled, fingernails digging deep into his palms as blood dripped between his fingers. "I will remember..." he whispered, his voice hoarse and terrible. "Today's grudge, I, Chen Ji... will never forget." He opened his eyes, crimson pupils burning with icy flames. Impulse is the devil—this truth he understood better than anyone. His father's vengeance, his mother's vengeance, his sister being taken away—账他要一笔一笔算清。He took a deep breath, storing the Jade Slip in his sleeve, and continued deeper into the forbidden land. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a hint of relief: "You made the right choice."

Regardless of the choice made, the exploration of the forbidden land's depths continued. The final section of the Jade Slip recorded the location of the complete Tianji Record—the ancestral master's last legacy. "What I was unable to accomplish in my time," the ancestral master's handwriting had grownweak, "must be entrusted to a later successor. The Tianji Record contains nine pages, scattered across heaven and earth. I gathered three of them, hidden in the deepest part of the forbidden land. There is also... a record of the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses." Chen Ji's heart震动, his pace unconsciously quickening. Weaknesses—this was precisely what he needed most!

At the end of the corridor stood a massive stone door. Intricate符文 covered its surface, emanating an ancient and vicissitudinous aura. Chen Ji stepped forward, pressing his palm against the door. The runes suddenly illuminated, and a surge of information directly entered his mind—"Only the master of the Tianji Record may enter." His heart stirred, and the Tianji Record flew from his sleeve, hovering above his palm. The patterns on the fragmented page resonated with the runes on the stone door, like reunited old friends. With a humming sound, the stone door slowly opened, a vast aura rushing toward him.

Beyond the stone door lay a vast expanse. Chen Ji stepped inside, and what met his eyes made his pupils constrict—a platform entirely condensed from purest spiritual energy floated three pages radiating golden light, the other three pages of the Tianji Record! And seated cross-legged at the platform's center was a ethereal figure. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying undisguised excitement: "That is... the ancestral master's remnant soul! He has been waiting here all along!" Just as Chen Ji was about to speak, the remnant soul slowly opened its eyes, its gaze penetrating a thousand years to fall upon Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "You have finally arrived... Inheritor of the Tianji Record."

text.content: The ancestral master's remnant soul smiled faintly, yet couldn't hide the fatigue and guilt in his eyes. "A thousand years..." his voice was distant as wind, "I have finally found someone capable of bearing this burden." Chen Ji clasped his hands in salute, yet remained vigilant: "Senior, you mentioned in the Jade Slip that the Tianji Record is not a creation of the Heavenly Eye... then what exactly is it?" The ancestral master's remnant soul sighed, gesturing with an empty hand. The three pages on the platform slowly drifted toward Chen Ji, merging with the fragment in his hand. The Tianji Record burst forth with dazzling radiance, as if coming alive.

"The Tianji Record," the ancestral master's voice was low and solemn, "is a supreme treasure left behind by a great cultivator of ancient times. Its sole purpose is one—to peer into heavenly secrets and foresee destiny." He paused, his gaze deepening. "And the Heavenly Eye is the celestial supervisor. It permits no existence to peer into destiny, for that would shake its dominion. The Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye are natural mortal enemies." Chen Ji drew a sharp breath, understanding suddenly dawning—难怪天机录会选中他，难怪天道之眼要杀他父亲。This was no coincidence, but a grudge spanning a thousand years!

The ancestral master's remnant soul began to dissipate; his strength couldn't sustain him much longer. "Child," he gazed at Chen Ji, eyes full of expectation, "the Tianji Record now has four pages, only five short of completion. But the true key lies not in collecting the fragments, but in..." his form grew increasingly faint, "whether you can find its core—that secret deliberately hidden by the Heavenly Eye. Go—the deepest part of the forbidden land holds the answers you seek... and the trials you must face..." Before his words could finish, the remnant soul had completely dissipated.

Chen Ji gripped the unified Tianji Record in his hand, the four pages emanating a gentle glow. Just as he prepared to venture deeper, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly erupted, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Chen Ji... it has come." No sooner had he spoken than the void above the platform tore apart. A colossal eye peered through the crack, enveloping the entire space. That eye still lacked a pupil, only endless pallor, yet radiated suffocating might. Chen Ji felt his very soul trembling—a oppressive sensation beyond realm, beyond comprehension—the manifested will of Heaven itself.

dialogue.content: [Heavenly Eye] "Mere ant... did you think that measly four pages could contend against Heaven?"

text.content: As that colossal eye dominating the heavens slowly opened, Chen Ji felt a pressure beyond any realm—not the aura any cultivator could emit, but the manifested will of Heaven itself. That eye gazed upon him as if observing an ant attempting to shake a great tree, absurd and laughable. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang in his mind: "Chen Ji! Now is not the time! Retreat quickly!" But Chen Ji stood his ground, head raised, directly facing that colossal eye. The hatred in his chest blazed like wildfire. He recalled his father's despair when being erased, his mother's dying entrustment, his sister missing for years... The blood debt of killing a father is unforgivable!
